name: rss-reader
title: RSS Reader
description: A per-chat RSS/Atom feed reader via /rss slash commands: subscribe to any RSS 2.0 or Atom feed (/rss add), list subscriptions with unread counts (/rss list), read the latest items of one feed or merged across all feeds newest-first (/rss read, /rss latest), refresh and only show what is new since the last read (/rss refresh), and unsubscribe (/rss remove — two-step confirm). Feed URLs and read-state live in per-chat storage; another chat starts with a clean subscription list. Network is intentionally UNRESTRICTED (no allowedHosts) — feeds can live on any host.
